attribution: Demand shape, item skew and day-level variability fitted to FreshRetailNet-50K (Wang, Gu, Long, Li, Shen, Fu, Zhou and Jiang, 'FreshRetailNet-50K: A Stockout-Annotated Censored Demand Dataset for Latent Demand Recovery and Forecasting in Fresh Retail', arXiv:2505.16319, 2025; https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dingdong-Inc/FreshRetailNet-50K, revision c374e85975c82816c495acfa904cc55ab14a47d3), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: sales rescaled to units, stock-out hours recovered, aggregated into profiles, quantiles and variance components; no row of the dataset is redistributed.
name: release-world-1

day_item_factors.source: item-day variance from fully in-stock days (CV^2 intercept less the store-day component); gamma form chosen; 16 equal-probability points

day_store_factors.source: store-day variance from co-movement of a store's series on fully in-stock days; gamma form chosen; 16 equal-probability points

item_count.source: 300 items: many skewed items as sealed, within the browser's budget (stage C); the data's stores carry 50 sampled series at the median, not their full assortment

items.price.source: unit prices: every term of J is proportional to price, so per-item decisions do not depend on it; the data carries no price

items.rate_per_day.source: FreshRetailNet-50K: per-series mean recovered daily demand over its own store's median (within-store skew), evenly spaced quantiles per category group, times the median store's median

items.shelf_life_hours.source: the data carries no shelf life: remaining life at receipt of 1, 2, 3, 5 or 7 days, spread evenly and independently of rate within each group (context, snippets only: 3 to 9 days in van Donselaar and Broekmeulen 2025); one global scale is the pre-declared calibration knob. Calibrated before freeze W by the session-5 gate's rule (section 7): the incumbent's waste share in N (units discarded over units sold, tuning seeds) was 2.38% at 1.0000; 3.09% at 0.7071, so every shelf life is times 0.7071067811865476, rounded to whole hours: 17, 34, 51, 85, 119 hours

items.supplier.source: category groups assigned to the three suppliers greedily by recovered volume, so a uniformly drawn supplier shock (S2, S3) strikes about a third of demand whichever is drawn

pair_share.source: slope s of CV^2 of daily totals on 1/mean across series: q = (s - 1) / (3 - s)

profiles.source: FreshRetailNet-50K: exposure-weighted profile estimator per category group and weekday, alternated to a fixed point; weekday levels from recovered day totals

suppliers.delivery_hours.source: 06:00 restock (FreshRetailNet-50K paper, section 3.2: stockouts below 2% after the 6 AM restock); a hub's second delivery at 15:00 (dark stores restock 2-3 times a day, TechCrunch 2024, snippet); 05:00 for chilled goods chosen

suppliers.lead_time_hours.source: order by 22:00 for a 06:00 fresh delivery, by 17:00 for 05:00 chilled, four hours from the hub: no source found for Indian dark stores
